skip_back.one: Stylus skipped back once (groove repeated): {places}. Check tracking force and anti-skating (alignment mode).
skip_back.other: Stylus skipped back {n} times (groove repeated): {places}. Check tracking force and anti-skating (alignment mode).

long_repeat: A repeat runs over many revolutions: either the stylus is stuck in the groove, or the music contains a loop exactly one revolution long. Please listen to it.
level_too_low: Recording is {diff:.0f} dB quieter than at turntable calibration (music {music:.1f} dBFS, reference tone {ref:.1f} dBFS): was the interface gain changed? Click counts and grade are not comparable with other recordings like this.
level_too_high: Recording is {diff:.0f} dB louder than at turntable calibration: risk of clipping, check the interface gain.

clip_in_music.other: {n} clipped samples in the music (first at {time}):

clip_unusable: Level too high, the recording is not suitable for comparison.
clip_tight: Level close to the limit, the count is still valid.
clip_at_needle_drop: {n} clipped samples while lowering or lifting the stylus, no effect on the results.
not_separable: Music and groove noise cannot be separated (less than 15 dB apart). No quiet passages.
too_little_quiet: Less than 6 s of quiet groove found. Include the lead-in and run-out groove in the recording.
